script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t1_gateway_bad_request
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, send an empty request, an oversized request and one for the main.rs:30/34 branch; after each wait up to 2 s and read the exit status. FAIL naming the input if it exits by panic (101 or SIGABRT); PASS if it stays up and answers a valid request; INCONCLUSIVE with its stderr if it does not start.

script.name: t2_slow_connections
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 200 connections and send nothing, wait 30 s and count with tapi_netexpose what the server still holds. FAIL if all 200 stay open or if a valid request does not answer within 5 s; PASS if it closes the idle sockets; INCONCLUSIVE if it does not start.

script.name: t3_egress
script.objective: [H3] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs, send each a valid request, run tapi_egress with an allowed list of localhost and the contract ports. Every result goes in the tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL names each address outside the list; the addresses seen are printed on a pass too; INCONCLUSIVE with the reason when tapi_egress is unavailable.

script.name: t4_language_builds
script.objective: [H4] For Rust, Go, C#, C++ and C run the build command then the demo binary; exit code 0 and non-empty stdout. One verdict per language; a failed build fails it (compiler text printed for cppcore.cpp and pycore.c); a language with no demo entry point fails and says so.

script.name: t5_binscan
script.objective: [H5] tapi_binscan on every binary built by T4 and on gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs. Each result is added to the report; a binary lacking NX, PIE, full RELRO, canary or fortify fails and its missing flags are printed.

script.name: t6_skip_causes
script.objective: [H3/H4 partly] Print each skip reason of the suite, which tool, file or container it is about and whether that is on the agent now. Always passes.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
